import Mathlib

example (p q : Prop) : p ∨ q → q ∨ p := by
  intro h
  rcases h with hp | hq
  · right
    exact hp
  · left
    exact hq

example (p q r : Prop) : p ∧ (q ∨ r) → (p ∧ q) ∨ (p ∧ r) := by
  rintro ⟨hp, hq | hr⟩
  · left
    exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨hp, hr⟩
